panels.content: Function-first far-future ordinary environment where humans, androids/robots/avatars may coexist through identity, access, maintenance and mobility infrastructure; present-day trajectory research is used as a question anchor, never as proof of exact future technology.

transportNavigation: mobility must accommodate different body/device needs
shoppingAvailability: ownership/access may differ between person, body, account and device
privacyRecords: identity credential, copy, backup and history disagreement are infrastructure questions
